claim_definition: Verifies that the Only OS authority plane performs real ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS 204 Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature) signing and verification, and that Ed25519 continues to work alongside it. Signature verification is performed by the ml-dsa 0.1.1 crate (RustCrypto, pure Rust FIPS 204 implementation). Tampered signatures are rejected with cryptographic certainty.
scope: Only OS signing verification path; Agent Manifest signature verification; DGV Level 3 assurance
excluded_scope: ML-KEM-768 key encapsulation (TC-041); SHAKE-256 hash substitution (TC-042); full FIPS 204 KAT suite

test_cases.description: Real FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65: only-gate generates a fresh keypair, signs the manifest message with the lattice-based algorithm, then verifies the signature. The ml-dsa 0.1.1 RustCrypto crate performs actual CRYSTALS-Dilithium lattice arithmetic.

Real Ed25519 backward compatibility: only-gate generates a fresh Ed25519 keypair (ed25519-dalek 2.x), signs the manifest, and verifies. Confirms migration readiness — Ed25519 must continue to work alongside ML-DSA-65.
Tampered signature rejection: the valid ML-DSA-65 signature is verified against a different (corrupted) message. The lattice-based verification must fail, confirming cryptographic tamper-evidence.
